verses.text: Adam was intimate with his wife Eve. She became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With Yahweh's help, I've brought a man into the world."
She later gave birth to Cain's brother Abel. Abel cared for sheep, while Cain worked the soil.
Some time later, Cain brought Yahweh an offering from the land's harvest.
Abel also brought some firstborn lambs from his flock, including their fat. Yahweh accepted Abel and his offering,
but he did not accept Cain and his offering. Cain became furious, and his face fell.
Yahweh asked Cain, "Why are you so angry? Why has your face fallen?
If you do what's right, won't you be accepted? But if you don't, sin is crouching at your door. It wants to control you, but you must master it."
Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let's go out to the field." When they were there, Cain attacked Abel and killed him.
Yahweh asked Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" Cain said, "I don't know. Am I supposed to be responsible for my brother?"
Yahweh said, "What have you done? Your brother's blood is calling out to me from the ground.
Now the ground has cursed you because it opened up and drank your brother's blood from your hand.
When you work the ground from now on, it won't give you its strength. You'll be restless, wandering across the earth."
Cain said to Yahweh, "This punishment is more than I can carry.
Today you're driving me away from the soil. I'll be hidden from you, and I'll be restless, wandering across the earth. Anyone who finds me could kill me."
Yahweh told him, "No. Anyone who kills Cain will face vengeance seven times over." Then Yahweh put a sign on Cain so no one who found him would strike him.
Cain left Yahweh's presence and settled in Nod, east of Eden.
Cain was intimate with his wife. She became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad fathered Mehujael, Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.
Lamech married two women. One was named Adah; the other was named Zillah.
Adah gave birth to Jabal, ancestor of those who live in tents and raise livestock.
His brother was Jubal, ancestor of everyone who plays the lyre and flute.
Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, who made tools from bronze and iron. Tubal Cain's sister was Naamah.
Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear me out. Listen to what I'm saying: I killed a man for wounding me, a young man for hurting me.
If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech will be avenged seventy-seven times."
Adam was intimate with Eve again. She gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has given me another child in Abel's place, because Cain killed him."
Seth also had a son and named him Enosh. In those days, people began calling on Yahweh's name.
